title: Cut your Claude Code bill in half (7 tactics)
description:
Most developers have no idea what they're actually spending on Claude Code.

Track usage with /cost, /stats, and /usage — built right in. Every session is logged in JSONL files under ~/.claude/projects/. Cap thinking tokens with one environment variable and cut your bill in half.

Full breakdown — 7 tactics to monitor and reduce your spend:
🔗 https://avinashsangle.com/blog/claude-code-cost-tracking
